mapper.select: WITH current_documents AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (kind) id, kind, required FROM consent_document WHERE kind IN ('TERMS','PRIVACY') AND effective_from <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ORDER BY kind, effective_from DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM current_documents)=2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM current_documents d WHERE d.required AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.document_id=d.id AND c.subject_user_id=#{userId} AND c.student_id IS NULL AND c.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM consent latest WHERE latest.document_id=d.id AND latest.subject_user_id=#{userId} AND latest.student_id IS NULL ORDER BY latest.agreed_at DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.agreed AND c.status='AGREED' AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL ) )

WITH current_guardian AS ( SELECT id, required FROM consent_document WHERE kind='GUARDIAN' AND effective_from <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ORDER BY effective_from DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_guardian d JOIN consent c ON c.document_id=d.id WHERE d.required AND c.subject_user_id=#{userId} AND c.student_id=#{studentId} AND c.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM consent latest WHERE latest.document_id=d.id AND latest.subject_user_id=#{userId} AND latest.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY latest.agreed_at DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.agreed AND c.status='AGREED' AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT ON (kind) id AS document_id, kind, version, title, content, required, effective_from FROM consent_document WHERE effective_from <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ORDER BY kind, effective_from DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT c.id AS consent_id, c.subject_user_id, c.student_id, c.agreed, c.status, c.agreed_at, c.withdrawn_at, d.id AS document_id, d.kind, d.version, d.title, d.content, d.required, d.effective_from FROM consent c JOIN consent_document d ON d.id=c.document_id WHERE c.subject_user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.agreed_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE consent SET status='WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{consentId} AND subject_user_id=#{userId}
